note: Delivered 7 of 20, well short of target. Most brand websites could not be fetched from the cloud (fetch permission blocks), so only brands whose own site I actually fetched are included; ones I could not verify were dropped rather than guessed. No HOT leads: none showed a dated reason to move now. Ads status is unknown for every lead. Empty email means none was found on the brand's own site. Several brands make health or efficacy claims on their own sites; keep outreach and creative product-led. Seltz's site lists contacto@seltz.com, a different domain, so it was left blank. Dotti's US location comes from third-party listings. US 1, MX 6.
